prompt:
Challenge C088-CH2: Membranes in dairy plants foul quickly and need cleaning every week.
Detail: At two dairy plants we service — one near Temerin, one outside

content.text: {"claims":[{"claim":1,"text":"Membrane fouling in protein-rich bioprocess streams can be characterised by atomic force microscopy and confocal laser scanning microscopy, with AFM height images revealing root-mean-square roughness values of 38–112 nm for fouled surfaces compared with 6–14 nm for clean membranes, and these data support mechanistic fouling models that distinguish surface coverage from pore blockage.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-03377","field":"abstract","quote":"Protein deposit layers formed during ultrafiltration of bovine serum albumin and β-lactoglobulin solutions were characterised by atomic force microscopy and confocal laser scanning microscopy"},{"id":"SYN-PUB-03377","field":"abstract","quote":"AFM height images revealed root-mean-square roughness values of 38–112 nm for fouled surfaces compared with 6–14 nm for clean membranes"},{"id":"SYN-PUB-03377","field":"abstract","quote":"These data support mechanistic fouling models that distinguish surface coverage from pore blockage"}]},{"claim":2,"text":"Pre-treatment with a commercial serine protease was evaluated as a fouling mitigation strategy prior to 30 kDa polyethersulphone ultrafiltration, and at a hydrolysis degree of 16%, the limiting flux increased by 38% compared with untreated broth, and the total fouling resistance measured at 2 bar TMP was reduced by 47%.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-03380","field":"abstract","quote":"Pre-treatment of a model fermentation broth with a commercial serine protease was evaluated as a fouling mitigation strategy prior to 30 kDa polyethersulphone ultrafiltration"},{"id":"SYN-PUB-03380","field":"abstract","quote":"At a hydrolysis degree of 16%, the limiting flux increased by 38% compared with untreated broth, and the total fouling resistance measured at 2 bar TMP was reduced by 47%"}]}]}
